import asyncio,importlib.util,json,time,traceback,math
from pathlib import Path
import yaml,rclpy
from launch import LaunchDescription,LaunchService
from launch.actions import RegisterEventHandler
from launch.event_handlers import OnProcessExit
from launch_ros.actions import Node
from lifecycle_msgs.srv import ChangeState
from nav2_msgs.srv import LoadMap
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('review_decoder','/review/keepout_config.py')
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
async def main():
 out=Path('/tmp/decoder-review');out.mkdir()
 (out/'ramp.pgm').write_bytes(b'P5\n256 1\n255\n'+bytes(range(256)))
 cases=[
  ('trinary',0,.25,.65),('trinary',1,.25,.65),
  ('trinary',0,50/255,165/255),('trinary',1,50/255,165/255),
  ('raw',0,.25,.65),('scale',0,.25,.65),('scale',1,.25,.65)]
 files=[]
 for i,(mode,negate,free,occupied) in enumerate(cases):
  meta={'image':'ramp.pgm','mode':mode,'resolution':.05,'origin':[0.,0.,0.],'negate':negate,'free_thresh':free,'occupied_thresh':occupied}
  p=out/f'case{i}.yaml';p.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(meta));files.append((p,meta))
 rclpy.init();node=rclpy.create_node('decoder_review_observer')
 process=Node(package='nav2_map_server',executable='map_server',name='decoder_review_map',parameters=[{'yaml_filename':str(files[0][0]),'use_sim_time':False}],output='screen')
 exits=[];handler=RegisterEventHandler(OnProcessExit(target_action=process,on_exit=lambda e,c:exits.append(e.returncode) or []))
 launch=LaunchService();launch.include_launch_description(LaunchDescription([process,handler]));task=asyncio.create_task(launch.run_async());start=time.monotonic()
 result={'ok':False,'scope':'Exhaustive256P5intensities vs actual installed ROS MapServer; decoder snapshot from peer, no adoption; no planner, Gazebo, goals or motors.','cases':[]}
 async def until(pred,seconds=15):
  deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   if task.done():raise RuntimeError('owned MapServer launch exited')
   rclpy.spin_once(node,timeout_sec=0.)
   if pred():return
   await asyncio.sleep(.01)
  raise RuntimeError('owned service observation timeout')
 try:
  c=node.create_client(ChangeState,'/decoder_review_map/change_state');await until(c.service_is_ready)
  for transition in (1,3):
   req=ChangeState.Request();req.transition.id=transition
   f=c.call_async(req);await until(f.done);assert f.result().success
  loader=node.create_client(LoadMap,'/decoder_review_map/load_map');await until(loader.service_is_ready)
  for (path,meta) in files:
   req=LoadMap.Request();req.map_url=str(path);f=loader.call_async(req);await until(f.done)
   response=f.result();assert response.result==0,response.result
   actual=bytes(v<0 for v in response.map.data)
   predicted=module._source_unknown_pixels(meta,bytes(range(256)))
   differences=[{'pixel':i,'mapserver_unknown':bool(a),'decoder_unknown':bool(b)} for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(actual,predicted)) if a!=b]
   assert len(actual)==len(predicted)==256
   result['cases'].append({'mode':meta['mode'],'negate':meta['negate'],'free_thresh':meta['free_thresh'],'occupied_thresh':meta['occupied_thresh'],'actual_unknown_count':sum(actual),'predicted_unknown_count':sum(predicted),'differences':differences})
  result['ok']=all(not c['differences'] for c in result['cases'])
 except Exception as e:result['error']=repr(e);result['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
 finally:
  await launch.shutdown();await asyncio.wait_for(task,20);node.destroy_node();rclpy.shutdown()
 result['process_exit_codes']=exits;result['seconds']=round(time.monotonic()-start,3)
 result['ok']=result['ok'] and exits==[0]
 result['cgroup']={p.name:p.read_text() for p in (Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak'),Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events')) if p.exists()}
 print('DECODER_REVIEW_RESULT '+json.dumps(result),flush=True)
 return 0 if result['ok'] else 1
raise SystemExit(asyncio.run(main()))
